name: Arc Converter - Automatic Item Processing
shortDesc: Auto-disassemble new weapons, craft ammunition, and convert junk into eddies

enabled.label: Enable Arc Converter
enabled.description: Master switch for automatic item processing.

disassemble.label: Weapons
disassemble.description: Process only newly acquired weapons. Existing weapons remain untouched.

tier1.label: Tier 1 (+ variants)
tier1.description: Disassemble eligible newly acquired Tier 1 weapons.

tier2.label: Tier 2 (+ variants)
tier2.description: Disassemble eligible newly acquired Tier 2 weapons.

tier3.label: Tier 3 (+ variants)
tier3.description: Disassemble eligible newly acquired Tier 3 weapons.

tier4.label: Tier 4 (+ variants)
tier4.description: Disassemble eligible newly acquired Tier 4 weapons.

tier5.label: Tier 5 (+ variants)
tier5.description: Disassemble eligible newly acquired Tier 5 weapons.

ammo.label: Automatically craft ammunition
ammo.description: Craft vanilla ammo for the equipped weapon using real components.

threshold.label: Craft when reserve below (%)
threshold.description: Trigger crafting when equipped weapon's ammunition is below this percentage of capacity.

sell_junk.label: Automatically process junk
sell_junk.description: Process junk and jewelry using the selected action, including existing stacks.

weapon_action.label: Weapon action
weapon_action.description: Sell eligible new weapons for eddies or disassemble them into components.

clothes_enabled.label: Clothes
clothes_enabled.description: Process only newly acquired clothing. Existing clothes remain untouched.

clothes_action.label: Clothes action
clothes_action.description: Sell eligible new clothes for eddies or disassemble them into components.

junk_action.label: Junk action
junk_action.description: Sell, disassemble or use the unit price threshold. Ineligible items are kept.

junk_price_threshold.label: Price threshold (€$)
junk_price_threshold.description: In By value mode, disassemble at or below this unit price; sell above it.

food_enabled.label: Food and drinks
food_enabled.description: Process eligible existing and newly acquired stacks. Off by default.

food_tier1.label: Tier 1
food_tier1.description: Keep, sell or disassemble if the game permits it.

food_tier2.label: Tier 2
food_tier2.description: Keep, sell or disassemble if the game permits it.

food_tier3.label: Tier 3
food_tier3.description: Keep, sell or disassemble if the game permits it.

food_tier4.label: Tier 4
food_tier4.description: Keep, sell or disassemble if the game permits it.

food_tier5.label: Tier 5
food_tier5.description: Keep, sell or disassemble if the game permits it.

boosters_enabled.label: Boosters
boosters_enabled.description: Process eligible existing and newly acquired stacks. Off by default.

boosters_tier1.label: Tier 1
boosters_tier1.description: Keep, sell or disassemble if the game permits it.

boosters_tier2.label: Tier 2
boosters_tier2.description: Keep, sell or disassemble if the game permits it.

boosters_tier3.label: Tier 3
boosters_tier3.description: Keep, sell or disassemble if the game permits it.

boosters_tier4.label: Tier 4
boosters_tier4.description: Keep, sell or disassemble if the game permits it.

boosters_tier5.label: Tier 5
boosters_tier5.description: Keep, sell or disassemble if the game permits it.

consumables_keep.label: Keep per stack
consumables_keep.description: Keep this many units of each eligible food, drink or booster stack.

ammo_much_better.label: Much Better Ammo
ammo_much_better.description: Enable crafting the four extra ammo types when Much Better Ammo is installed. Does nothing without it.

ammo_dual_wield.label: Expanded Dual Wielding / both hands
ammo_dual_wield.description: Check both active weapons using native game APIs; shared ammo is crafted only once.
